brief:
More than 85 percent of Gaza Civil Defence vehicles are out of service, Al Jazeera English reported, severely hampering rescue operations across the territory. The breakdown of the fleet has left crews unable to reach trapped people effectively, compounding the humanitarian crisis.

The civil defence has not provided detailed information on the causes of the widespread vehicle failures or timelines for repairs and replacements needed to restore operational capacity.
dek: More than 85 percent of Gaza Civil Defence vehicles are out of service as crews struggle to reach trapped people.
title: Gaza Civil Defence fleet crippled as rescue operations falter
